column5: WriteType and LockType bytes plus EncodeWriteCFValue and ParseWriteCFValue are translated with the source remainder semantics; EncodeLockCFValue and DB-backed write batches remain open because they depend on lock payloads, badger, and kvproto.
DbUserMeta, key timestamp suffix decoding, and extra transaction-status key encode/decode are typed safely; DecodeLock, MarshalBinary, ToLockInfo, and the unsafe Go lock layout remain explicit gaps.
